title: Immersive Apothic
description: Compat for Apothic Enchanting and Immersive Enchanting.
body:
Make sure you also install [Apotheosis](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/apotheosis) 

NOTE: I'll depreciate this if Immersive Enchanting adds compatibility with Apotheosis natively; this is just a temporary "fix".

This mod has two main features:

**1.** Prioratizes Immersive Enchanting's GUI over Apothic Enchanting.

  **1.1** Just Immersive Enchanting and Apotheosis
  > ![Just Immersive Enchanting and Apotheosis](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/583e5b25839c8f541b3138ee019707c347b0ccaa_0.webp)

  1.2 Using Immersive Apothic mod alongside Immersive Enchanting and Apotheosis
  > ![Using Immersive Apothic mod alongside Immersive Enchanting and Apotheosis](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65b8750573af0763ff5480f1b56fe88e5da8304e.png)


**2.** Adjusts Enchantment Costs for various vanilla + modded enchantments.

Vanilla & Modded Enchantments follow this formula I've done a few mods but if there's any missing it's easy to setup a datapack just follow the steps on Immersive Enchanting's [Wiki](https://immersive-enchanting.fandom.com/wiki/For_Modpack_Developers)

```json
 COST_PER_LEVEL = {
  "item": 
  "minecraft:amethyst_shard", 
  "amount": 3, <<<<<<<<<<<<<<<< Increased by 3 per level
  "xp_levels": 5 <<<<<<<<<<<<<< Increased by 5 per level
  }
```
